_comment: Cross-cutting fingerprint synonym groups (design §2③). Hitting any member of a group at query time injects the group's other tokenized terms for RECALL only — deterministic, never random. A new fingerprint synonym is a table edit here, never a code change to the _has_* probes. Tokens are matched after lowercase alphanumeric tokenization, so symbolic members (e.g. '{{ }}') contribute their word tokens.
